summary: Tested backend APIs (15/15 passed) and frontend flows end-to-end. Found and fixed one CRITICAL frontend bug in App.js DashboardContent that broke the /dashboard route entirely. After fix: admin login -> Admin Panel renders, sidebar works, logout works, register form available. Landing page, islands, and theme/language toggles render correctly.

minor.issue: backend/.env FRONTEND_URL='http://localhost:3000' but production frontend is https://knowledge-islands-1.preview.emergentagent.com. FastAPI CORSMiddleware allow_origins is only localhost. Currently the Kubernetes ingress overrides with 'access-control-allow-origin: *', so requests succeed in practice, but this masks a misconfiguration. With credentials=true and a wildcard origin, browsers would reject cookies if the ingress weren't there. Update FRONTEND_URL to the deployed origin or accept a list.
Cookies set with secure=False on an HTTPS site. Works because the ingress proxy strips/handles it, but should be secure=True in production HTTPS environments. samesite='lax' is correct.

These endpoints declare arguments as plain function params, so FastAPI treats them as QUERY PARAMETERS (not JSON body). This is almost certainly unintended - clients sending JSON will get 422. Wrap inputs in a Pydantic BaseModel.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Code did `const { user } = React.useContext(React.createContext(null));` which threw 'Cannot destructure property user of useContext(...) as it is null' on every dashboard render, breaking the /dashboard index route after a successful login. Also used CommonJS `require('@/contexts/AuthContext')` in an ESM React app. Replaced with proper `useAuth()` import.

integration_issues.issue: DashboardLayout.handleLogout calls navigate('/') but user ends up on /auth (because ProtectedRoute redirects unauthenticated users). Functionally OK (session cleared, toast shown), but the explicit navigate target is misleading.

action_items: Update backend/.env FRONTEND_URL to the deployed frontend origin (https://knowledge-islands-1.preview.emergentagent.com) or make CORS allow_origins a list including it. Do not rely on ingress wildcard for credentialed CORS.
Set secure=True on auth cookies for HTTPS deployments (consider an env-driven flag).
Convert POST /api/subjects, /api/lessons, /api/progress to accept Pydantic body models instead of query params.
Verify the DashboardContent fix (already applied) and add an ErrorBoundary around dashboard routes to avoid full-page red overlays in future regressions.
Consider redirecting logout to '/' explicitly and ensure ProtectedRoute does not race the navigate.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js DashboardContent had broken context usage + CommonJS require inside React component - clear sign of generated/AI-written code that wasn't run. Fixed.
server.py mixes query-param and JSON body endpoints inconsistently for admin/teacher actions.
init_storage() runs synchronously inside @app.on_event('startup') using `requests` (blocking) and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY placeholder, which logs a warning but doesn't break the app. Acceptable for now.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented despite the playbook expectation (login_attempts collection is indexed but never written/read). Add lockout after 5 failed logins.
JWT secret stored in .env (good), but no refresh-token rotation endpoint - /api/auth/refresh listed in test_credentials.md is missing from server.py.
seed_data_creation: Test student users created dynamically per test run via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix-like UUID emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App.js DashboardContent was patched by previous testing agent. Admin login -> /dashboard now renders AdminDashboard correctly. The auth flow uses httpOnly cookies which the browser sends automatically (axios withCredentials:true). Backend CORS config in .env still says localhost - works only because k8s ingress sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. /api/auth/refresh endpoint is referenced in docs/credentials but NOT implemented in server.py.
rca of the issue: RCA - /dashboard crash: App.js line 60 did `React.useContext(React.createContext(null))` which returns the default value null, then destructured `{user}` from null -> TypeError. Additionally line 61 used CommonJS `require('@/contexts/AuthContext').useAuth()` in a Webpack/ESM bundle. Reproduction: login as admin -> redirect to /dashboard -> red error overlay 'Cannot destructure property user of useContext(...) as it is null'. Fix: import { useAuth } at top of App.js and use `const { user: currentUser } = useAuth();` inside DashboardContent.
